verdict.rationale: Codegen documents general natural-language-to-code agent capabilities and a Figma connector, which could plausibly enable design-to-implementation workflows, but there is no evidence of an actual mockup/design import flow, PM-facing UI, or end-to-end case study showing a non-engineer going from a design file to a merged implementation. missing for 10: dedicated design-to-code workflow docs, PM-oriented UX, evidence of Figma mockup ingestion producing working code, and any case study of a non-engineering handoff.
